decision.selection: checkpoints at steps 300,600,...,1800 (and Step0); the one with the best validation F1 (IoU>=.30, conf>=.30) is the candidate; test sets are never read for selection
decision.productGate: frozen CDC native-acne-acceptance (SHA 90dc84fa...): precision, recall and F1 >= .80 at one-to-one IoU>=.30, unignored unmatched = FP, >=50 positive + >=50 negative independent photos, negative FP <= 1/photo

outcome.A: candidate meets the productGate numbers on the cross-source test AND, on the product-chain sets, gains targets vs Step0 with Scope B reviewed-negative FP <= Step0 (3) and unusedEval unmatched candidates <= 1.5 x Step0 (254)
outcome.Bplus: candidate is better than Step0 on cross-source F1 by >= .10 and does not violate the product-chain FP limits above, but misses the productGate numbers

decision.frozen: no change of thresholds, IoU, denominators, test sets or steps after the first test prediction

trainable: YOLOX head + PAFPN neck convs (BatchNorm frozen, eval mode); backbone frozen; start = CDC Step0
